_comment: MyCover purchase FAMILIES — pure data, no code changes needed to add one.
MyCover has no generic bind endpoint. Purchase endpoints are per product
FAMILY: POST /products/{family}/buy-{family-slug}. One family path serves
many products; the specific product is chosen by a `product_id` UUID in the
request BODY (the `id` from GET /products/get-all-products).
Family names are their OWN namespace. They need not match any product name,
prefix or route_name: /products/bastion/buy-medisure is live although no
product is called 'MediSure'. Deriving a path from route_name is a CONFIRMED
DEAD END — bastion-flexicare-mini, goxi-artisan-basic, allianz-travel-cover
and sti-flexi-guard all 404 that way.
HOW TO ADD A FAMILY (data change only):
1. Probe the candidate path: POST it with an empty body {}.
404 'Cannot POST ...' => the path does not exist.
400 (validation array) or 403 => the path exists.
2. The 400 body enumerates every required field, its type, its length
bounds and its enum values. That IS the form schema. Probing is safe:
validation rejects before anything is created.
3. Add an entry below with the path, its matcher, and the schema.
MATCHING: a product joins a family when `product_codes` lists its provider
route_name (authoritative), or when `match.prefix` and, if present,
`match.category` both apply (inferred). Explicit always wins. A product that
matches NO family gets no buy path and cannot bind — the adapter fails closed
rather than posting to a guessed endpoint.
membership: 'verified' means real purchases have gone through this family for
these products. 'inferred' means the PATH is verified live but which products
it accepts is an assumption from the prefix/category — treat a bind failure
on an inferred product as a mapping bug, not a member error.
path_verified is TRUE only when BOTH the path exists AND its form schema is captured here.
A path that merely 'exists' (probe returned non-404) is NOT enough: binding with an unknown
field set fails validation AFTER the member has been debited. Same for the two 403
scope-blocked Life families — a 403 at purchase time is a debit for cover that cannot issue.

families.notes: Health plans. payment_plan is an instalment COUNT of 1-12 months and changes what the member is charged; MyCover's instalment pricing rule is unverified, so the adapter refuses to quote any plan other than 1.

fields.name: image_url
fields.label: Passport photograph
fields.help: Must be a PUBLICLY reachable image URL. MyCover fetches and content-checks this URL, so a presigned or private link fails validation.

fields.name: payment_plan
fields.label: Payment plan (months)
fields.help: Instalment count. Only 1 (pay in full) is currently supported.

families.notes: Device cover. device_value has a provider minimum of 50,000 NAIRA (not kobo) — the value the member types is naira, converted at the adapter boundary like every other amount.

fields.name: id_image_url
fields.label: ID document
fields.help: Must be a PUBLICLY reachable image URL. MyCover fetches and content-checks this URL, so a presigned or private link fails validation.

fields.name: device_about_image_url
fields.label: Photo of the device
fields.help: Must be a PUBLICLY reachable image URL. MyCover fetches and content-checks this URL, so a presigned or private link fails validation.
